name: Happy valentines day
source:
Coexistence with vampires. Valentine's Day. Club. She is looking for him. He appeared in her dreams, but who is this 'he'? Best friend, acquaintance, star or casual visitor?

[Translated from [url=https://koshimore.itch.io/happy-valentines-day]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与吸血鬼共存。情人节。俱乐部。她正在找他。他出现在她的梦里，可这个‘他’是谁？最好的朋友、熟人、明星还是偶然的访客？

[译自[url=https://koshimore.itch.io/happy-valentines-day]itch.io[/url]]
